# Solution: ACK-Managed S3 Logs Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

## File Structure

```
infra/s3/logs/
├── base/
│   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   ├── bucket.yaml
│   ├── versioning.yaml
│   ├── encryption.yaml
│   └── public-access-block.yaml
└── overlays/
    ├── dev/
    │   ├── kustomization.yaml
    │   └── patch-bucket.yaml
    └── prod/
        ├── kustomization.yaml
        └── patch-bucket.yaml

infra/iam/irsa-logs/
├── base/
│   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   ├── role.yaml
│   ├── policy.yaml
│   └── role-policy-attachment.yaml
└── overlays/
    ├── dev/
    │   ├── kustomization.yaml
    │   ├── patch-role.yaml
    │   └── patch-policy.yaml
    └── prod/
        ├── kustomization.yaml
        ├── patch-role.yaml
        └── patch-policy.yaml

flux/
└── kustomizations.yaml   (updated)
```

---

## 1. S3 Bucket — Base

### `infra/s3/logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - versioning.yaml
  - encryption.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml

labels:
  - includeSelectors: false
    pairs:
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
      app.kubernetes.io/component: s3-logs
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forResource:
    bucket: myapp-logs
    objectLockEnabledForBucket: false
    tags:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
  managementPolicies:
    - "*"
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
spec:
  forResource:
    bucketNameRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    status: Enabled
  managementPolicies:
    - "*"
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/encryption.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-encryption
spec:
  forResource:
    bucketNameRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  managementPolicies:
    - "*"
```

### `infra/s3/logs/base/public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-public-access-block
spec:
  forResource:
    bucketNameRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  managementPolicies:
    - "*"
```

---

## 2. S3 Bucket — Overlays

### `infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

patches:
  - path: patch-bucket.yaml

labels:
  - includeSelectors: false
    pairs:
      app.kubernetes.io/environment: dev
```

### `infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/patch-bucket.yaml`

```yaml
# Patch the bucket name for the dev environment
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: default
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-versioning
  namespace: default
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-encryption
  namespace: default
---
apiVersion: s3.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: S3BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-public-access-block
  namespace: default
```

> **Note:** Since ACK S3 resources are named by their bucket name (and the `forResource.bucket` field is the actual AWS resource name), the cleanest approach is to use `namePrefix`/`nameSuffix` or strategic merge patches. Below is the **recommended** approach using a single strategic merge patch on the bucket and relying on the `bucketNameRef` resolution:

**Simpler and more correct approach** — rename via `namePrefix` and patch the `forResource.bucket` field:

### `infra/s3/logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` (revised)

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

namePrefix: ""
namespace: default

patches:
  - target:
      kind: S3Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucket
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forResource/tags/environment
        value: dev

  - target:
      kind: S3BucketVersioning
      name: myapp-logs-versioning
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucketNameRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev

  - target:
      kind: S3BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
      name: myapp-logs-encryption
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucketNameRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev

  - target:
      kind: S3BucketPublicAccessBlock
      name: myapp-logs-public-access-block
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucketNameRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev

labels:
  - includeSelectors: false
    pairs:
      app.kubernetes.io/environment: dev
```

### `infra/s3/logs/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

namespace: default

patches:
  - target:
      kind: S3Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucket
        value: myapp-logs-prod
      - op: add
        path: /spec/forResource/tags/environment
        value: prod

  - target:
      kind: S3BucketVersioning
      name: myapp-logs-versioning
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucketNameRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-prod

  - target:
      kind: S3BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
      name: myapp-logs-encryption
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucketNameRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-prod

  - target:
      kind: S3BucketPublicAccessBlock
      name: myapp-logs-public-access-block
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/bucketNameRef/name
        value: myapp-logs-prod

labels:
  - includeSelectors: false
    pairs:
      app.kubernetes.io/environment: prod
```

## 3. IAM Role for IRSA — Base

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/base/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - role.yaml
  - policy.yaml
  - role-policy-attachment.yaml

labels:
  - includeSelectors: false
    pairs:
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
      app.kubernetes.io/component: irsa-logs
```

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/base/role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRole
metadata:
  name: irsa-myapp-logs
spec:
  forResource:
    name: irsa-myapp-logs
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "PLACEHOLDER_OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "PLACEHOLDER_OIDC_ISSUER:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:myapp-logs",
                "PLACEHOLDER_OIDC_ISSUER:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: irsa-myapp-logs
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
  managementPolicies:
    - "*"
```

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/base/policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-s3-access
spec:
  forResource:
    name: myapp-logs-s3-access
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "AllowS3LogsAccess",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
              "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "PLACEHOLDER_BUCKET_ARN_OBJECTS"
            ]
          },
          {
            "Sid": "AllowS3ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:GetBucketLocation",
              "s3:GetBucketVersioning"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "PLACEHOLDER_BUCKET_ARN"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: myapp-logs-s3-access
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: knr-ops
  managementPolicies:
    - "*"
```

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/base/role-policy-attachment.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.aws-upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: IAMRolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: irsa-myapp-logs-attachment
spec:
  forResource:
    policyArnRef:
      name: myapp-logs-s3-access
    roleNameRef:
      name: irsa-myapp-logs
  managementPolicies:
    - "*"
```

## 4. IAM Role for IRSA — Overlays

### `infra/iam/irsa-logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - ../../base

namespace: default

patches:
  # Replace OIDC placeholders with dev cluster values
  # In production repos, these values come from a SOPS-encrypted
  # parameters file or are injected by CI.
  - target:
      kind: IAMRole
      name: irsa-myapp-logs
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/assumeRolePolicy
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {
                  "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID"
                },
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                "Condition": {
                  "StringEquals": {
                    "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:myapp-logs",
                    "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                  }
                }
              }
            ]
          }

  - target:
      kind: IAMPolicy
      name: myapp-logs-s3-access
    patch: |
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forResource/policy
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {
                "Sid": "AllowS3LogsAccess",
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Action": [
                  "s3:GetObject",
                  "s3:PutObject",
                  "s3:DeleteObject",
                  "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
                  "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
                ],

                  "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
                ]

                  "s3:GetBucketVersioning"
                ],
                "Resource": [
                  "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"
                ]
              }
            ]
          }

labels:
  - includeSelectors: false
    pairs:
      app.kubernetes.io/environment: dev
```
